collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - VILLAGE MOMENTS (VFX-01..12, draft for the owner, 2026-11-18)
Songs, chants and speeches, a long lazy afternoon, rain on the way, a roof patched with cloth: small moments where the whole village does something together, and the island answers.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks an adult)
the heading's "(VV3 only)": the event is The Secret City only
the draft's effect, never shown: the outcome's effect

collection.description: A fizzing potion by the alchemy table: take a sip, or pour it away.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Someone left a pot of half-finished potion by the alchemy table, and it is fizzing in a way nobody likes the look of. (name1) is curious enough to want a taste.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (name1) takes a sip. For the rest of the morning, every few words come out with a hiccup, and the children follow (him/her) around just to hear it.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (name1) pours it into the bushes. The bushes fizz quietly for an hour and then seem perfectly happy.
